title: Coefficient-square coherence of normalized sheaf Hom chain maps
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe, and let $R,S,R',S'$ be sheaves of commutative rings, with maps $\varphi:R\to S$, $a:R\to R'$, $b:S\to S'$, $\varphi':R'\to S'$ satisfying $b\varphi=\varphi'a$. Use module sheaves, ordinary sheafified tensor, restriction, and actual unbounded product Hom complexes $H_R,H_S,H_{R'},H_{S'}$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] [def-pur-hom-complex]. Put $E=E_\varphi$, $A=E_a$, $B=E_b$, $E'=E_{\varphi'}$ for termwise ordinary scalar extension, and $U=U_\varphi$, $U'=U_{\varphi'}$ for restriction. Put $T_\psi(X)=\operatorname{Res}_\psi(\text{target ring of }\psi)\otimes_{\text{source ring of }\psi}X$.
Suppose for each of these ring maps and their composites we are given the chain maps of [lem-sfb-slice-scalar-hom-chain-adjunction] [lem-sfb-scalar-hom-chain-evaluation], normalized on every slice by
$$\nu_\psi(s\otimes x)=s\otimes x,\quad\theta_\psi(g)(p)=g(1\otimes p),\quad\alpha_\psi(s\otimes f)(p)=s\otimes f(p),\quad\sigma^\psi_q(s\otimes f)(t\otimes p)=stq(1\otimes f(p)).$$
These are statements about the actual product coordinates and identity-of-slice evaluations; pure tensors are sheafification-unit images [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Write $\chi_\psi(P,J)=\sigma^\psi_{\mathrm{id}_{E_\psi J}}:E_\psi H(P,J)\to H(E_\psi P,E_\psi J)$.
There exist natural chain isomorphisms $\kappa_X:BEX\xrightarrow{\sim}E'AX$ and natural chain maps $\mu_N:AUN\to U'BN$, $\tau_X:AT_\varphi X\to T_{\varphi'}AX$, with formulas
$$\kappa_X(s'\otimes(s\otimes x))=s'b(s)\otimes(1\otimes x),\quad\kappa_X^{-1}(s'\otimes(r'\otimes x))=s'\varphi'(r')\otimes(1\otimes x),$$
$$\mu_N(r'\otimes z)=\varphi'(r')\otimes z,\qquad\tau_X(r'\otimes(s\otimes x))=\varphi'(r')b(s)\otimes(1\otimes x).$$
For every $R$-complexes $P,J$, $S$-complex $N$, $S'$-complex $N'$, and chain maps $q:EJ\to N$, $w:BN\to N'$, $q':E'AJ\to N'$ satisfying $q'\kappa_J=wB(q)$, the following equalities of chain maps hold (composition is right to left):
$$\nu_{\varphi',AX}\tau_X=U'(\kappa_X)\mu_{EX}A(\nu_{\varphi,X}),$$
$$H_{R'}(AP,\mu_N)\chi_a(P,UN)A(\theta_{\varphi,P,N})=\theta_{\varphi',AP,BN}\,U'\bigl(H_{S'}(\kappa_P^{-1},\mathrm{id})\chi_b(EP,N)\bigr)\mu_{H_S(EP,N)},$$
$$H_{R'}(AP,\tau_J)\chi_a(P,T_\varphi J)A(\alpha_{\varphi,P,J})=\alpha_{\varphi',AP,AJ}\,T_{\varphi'}(\chi_a(P,J))\tau_{H_R(P,J)},$$
$$H_{S'}(\kappa_P^{-1},w)\chi_b(EP,N)B(\sigma^\varphi_q)=\sigma^{\varphi'}_{q'}\,E'(\chi_a(P,J))\kappa_{H_R(P,J)}.$$
Here $H(u,v)$ is the contravariant/covariant Hom action, and $H(AP,-)$ has identity first input. The maps and equations agree for identity coefficient changes and for composite coefficient squares under the iterated-extension associators $c\otimes(d\otimes x)\mapsto cd\otimes x$, whose inverses insert $1$. The same compatibility holds for any further compatible semilinear target map by its induced map $w:BN\to N'$. No flatness or boundedness is required and no Hom comparison $\chi_\psi$ is assumed invertible.
